reading.body:
Profit Finder Pro Software is not a data center and has zero megawatts of capacity. It is a CRM and sales-tracking product for small businesses, and its Scottsdale address is occupied by TraVek Inc.

The listing is a mistagged OpenStreetMap point marked telecom=data_center. No specifications are published, and research has exhausted available sources without finding any connection to server infrastructure or colocation equipment.

For AI infrastructure, this record adds no compute, building, or power demand. It should not be included in assessments of grid constraints, and it does not contribute to the 512 MW of published capacity mapped across Arizona's four facilities with published figures. The data does not describe any actual data center operations in Maricopa County, only a misclassified software business.
